explanation: Eight bits give 256 different combinations, enough for every letter, digit and symbol on an English keyboard. Half a byte, four bits, is jokingly called a nibble.

claims.text: In the modern standard, a byte is made up of 8 bits.
A modern byte is not 2, 4 or 16 bits.
Eight bits can represent 256 different combinations.
256 combinations are enough to encode every letter, digit and symbol on an English keyboard.
Four bits, half a byte, are called a nibble.
